readme.run: Segment organs, bones, vertebrae and muscles in a 3D CT or MRI scan
notes: All 12 openly licensed Apache-2.0 TotalSegmentator v2 ONNX models are included and verified locally.
No network connection, Python, PyTorch or previously populated cache is required.
Use --task total (default), total_mr, vertebrae_mr or abdominal_muscles.
Use --resolution fast (3 mm, default) or full (1.5 mm) with optional --subset filtering.
Add --help for all options. DICOM import and mask editing use the web app.
TotalSegmentator is research software, not a clinical diagnosis. Please cite:
Wasserthal J, Breit HC, Meyer MT, et al. TotalSegmentator: Robust Segmentation of 104 Anatomic
Structures in CT Images. Radiology: Artificial Intelligence. 2023;5(5):e230024.
D'Antonoli TA, Berger LK, Indrakanti AK, et al. TotalSegmentator MRI. Radiology. 2025;314(2):e241613.
